BiblicalUsage: Near is the promise of the whole Bible: what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is; the LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and the LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe nearness is the heart of the covenant, because God is not far off, He is nigh to the broken and to the calling.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
